title: JPMorgan Chase: Legal Technology Strategy & Transformation
tagline: Connected business priorities to technology strategy, product governance, multi-year roadmaps, financial and workforce planning, and executive decision-making across a global Legal Technology organization.
description:
## The challenge

In Legal Technology, the challenge is not simply delivering isolated projects. It is aligning different product areas, technical teams, business partners, resources, and control obligations around a coherent set of priorities. I led the management processes that helped translate those priorities into plans, ownership, governance, and delivery accountability.

## My contribution

Annual strategy cycle, portfolio and roadmap alignment, financial and workforce planning, organizational operating-model improvements, executive reviews, and AI opportunity prioritization.

## Outcome

Helped establish clearer priorities, accountability, and decision-making across the technology portfolio.
